verdicts.quote: Automatic promotion: when a place opens, the first eligible waitlisted member is booked automatically; no claim window or "confirm within N minutes" step.

entries are ordered by the order the service accepted the joins (a service-assigned sequence, not a client or wall-clock time, so two joins in the same millisecond still have a defined order) ... Out of scope: priority tiers, manual reordering, staff override (PD-2).
for each head-of-queue member it re-checks the member's current eligibility using the same rules as a direct booking (ASM-4)
verdicts.missing: Whether promotion into one class removes or resolves the member's entry on an overlapping class's waitlist; time conflicts are only an assumed, unknown eligibility rule (ASM-4).

verdicts.quote: Spot opening inside any late-cancel/penalty window of the existing app: the promoted booking is subject to whatever the existing rules say; the rule itself is unknown (G-4b).
verdicts.missing: How the existing late-cancel/no-show policy applies to a promoted booking (e.g. a member auto-promoted close to start who then cancels or doesn't attend); left as open gap G-4b.

verdicts.quote: whenever a full-open class gains k ≥ 1 free places through any spot-opening trigger (T-a..T-d), the service, as part of the same operation that opened the place and before it returns, promotes up to k waitlisted members

the promoted member is told: class name, start time, "you were promoted from the waitlist" ... in-app marker ... any existing outbound channel ... delivery failure does not undo the promotion ... interim: one attempt, failure recorded
S6: cap 2 booked {Ana, Ben}, waitlist [Cai]; Ana and Ben cancel, in either order → bookings {Cai} plus one free place; Cai is promoted exactly once
a waitlisted member cannot book directly (ALREADY_WAITLISTED), so no member is ever both.
Out of scope: payments, credit deduction or fees specific to waitlist (the existing booking rules apply as they do to direct bookings).
verdicts.missing: When payment/credit is taken for an auto-promoted booking and what happens to the promotion if payment or credit deduction fails.

verdicts.quote: Waitlist length cap: unresolved (G-1a); interim behaviour is no cap. ... WAITLIST_FULL only once a cap exists (G-1a).
verdicts.missing: The cap value, and what the member sees in the UI when the waitlist is full.

verdicts.quote: Waitlist entries end at class start; promotions can occur at any time before start. ... Auto-promotion needs no reaction window, so no pre-start cutoff is needed.

(T-c) capacity +3 with 2 waiting promotes both and leaves 1 place for direct booking ... If staff reduce capacity below confirmed bookings ... the waitlist rule is only that no promotion happens until confirmed < capacity.
staff cancel class C-101 with waitlist [Cai, Dee] → both entries end class_cancelled; no bookings are created; both are notified.
creates one waitlist entry {class, member, join order, status} ... an entry stores the member id, class id, order and timestamps only.
expired (class started) ... The terminal record keeps {class, member id, reason, ended-at} ... Retention period of terminal records: unresolved (G-7b).
verdicts.missing: How long terminal records are kept (interim 'keep' with no period).

verdicts.quote: Members see their own position and the total waiting count, never other members' identities.
Staff visibility of waitlist contents: not requested, no staff screen is added (G-10).
verdicts.missing: Whether staff can view the waitlist, promote or remove members by hand, and see promotion history; deferred as out of scope / open gap G-10.

verdicts.quote: promotion has completed by the time the operation that opened the place returns (R-4)
these remain exactly as before ... (a) booking a class with space and an empty waitlist ... (f) existing data and screens for members with no waitlist.
